meta.title: {{faction}} Final Stand Technologies - COH3
meta.description: The full Final Stand technology draft of {{faction}} in Company of Heroes 3 - every unit, ability and passive that can be offered, pick by pick.

page.title: {{faction}} Final Stand Technologies
page.subtitle: The technology draft, pick by pick. Every pick offers {{choices}} of the technologies below and you can hold {{slots}} of them at a time.
page.notAvailable: The Final Stand technologies data is not available at the moment. Please try again later.

summary.slotsTooltip: Technologies you can hold at the same time during a Final Stand run.

filters.commonTooltip: Technologies every faction can be offered. Turn off to see only the technologies of this faction.

pick.title: Pick {{pick}}
pick.waveTooltip: The wave this pick happens after. Wave 0 is the setup phase before the first wave.
pick.poolTooltip: How many technologies the game offers and how many it can pick them from.
pick.empty: No technology of this pick matches the filters.

tech.commonTooltip: Every faction can be offered this technology.
tech.waveTooltip: The waves this technology can be offered in. Only the passive picks respect it - the unit and ability picks ignore it.
tech.disabledTooltip: This technology is in the game files but switched off, so it cannot be offered.
tech.noDescription: No description in the game files

unreachable.title: Not offered in the draft
unreachable.subtitle: These technologies are in the game files but their wave window lies outside the picks of a run, so the draft never offers them.
